consequence.statement: This is a new feature addition; no operational consequence for existing deployments.

original.statement: Support for Kubernetes client impersonate flags has been added to istioctl.

decision.reason: [ev-eb9884e0aaab] describes only an addition: istioctl gains support for the kube client impersonate flags. Nothing in it says any existing behaviour changes, fails, is rejected or must be migrated. An operator who does nothing is unaffected, so a consequence of "none" (informational) matches what the evidence says.
